snippet.title: Heptic Arena - Pre-Alpha Trailer - Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Witness the first gameplay glimpse of Heptic Arena, our upcoming PvPvE Online Multiplayer Battle Arena Shooter! Wishlist Heptic Arena on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707850/Heptic_Arena/

Heptic Arena blends intense PvP combat with challenging PvE elements, forcing you to contend with both rival players and dangerous environmental threats. Are you ready to become the next champion of the cosmos?

Get ready, contenders. The Arena is calling!
